responsibility: Implements the core Solaris target helper routines behind the policy declared in sol2.h. It applies pending Solaris pragma-derived attributes to declarations, emits .init and .fini section calls for functions marked with Solaris init/fini attributes, outputs Solaris visibility directives with Sun assembler syntax, manages COMDAT/group-section emission and deferred signature-symbol definition for Sun as, and adjusts option defaults such as downgrading DWARF version when older Solaris linkers cannot handle newer .eh_frame encodings. This is the backend/output side of Solaris target support rather than the frontend pragma parser.
same_name_distinction: This is the out-of-line implementation file in the sol2 same-name group: it realizes Solaris helper logic such as applying pragma-derived attributes, emitting .init/.fini calls, Sun assembler visibility directives, COMDAT/group-section handling, and option overrides, whereas gcc/config/sol2.h declares the Solaris macros/specs and wires these hooks in, and gcc/config/sol2.opt only lists Solaris options.
